notes.title: New this February: Armoury
notes.content:
[img]http://gf1.geo.gfsrv.net/cdncb/8057bf58a373e62af11f8aea8f504e.jpg[/img]

Soldiers,

It's time to stock up your arsenal - not only are there new deployment locations waiting for you, there's also some hot new equipment.

[h1]NEW VIP MAP: ARMOURY[/h1]

A new Blasting map can now be hosted exclusively by VIPs: the 'Armoury'.

[h1]ADDITIONAL MODE FOR 'OFFICE' MAP[/h1]

The 'Office' map is now available for the AI mode Team Death Match.

[h1]SPECIAL ORGELBOX: GLADIUS COLLECTION[/h1]

Can't get enough of the Gladius series? Us too! For this reason, there's a special offering now available: the Gladius Collection. It contains the FAMAS Gladius, the M4A1 Gladius, the G36C Gladius and the brand new M40A1 Gladius.

[h1]MP7A1 NAGA[/h1]

Arm up with the highly efficient assault rifle, the MP7A1 Naga! You can buy this solid firearm in the capsule market. It heralds from Germany and is considered as the new generation of high performance submachine guns. Its low weight makes the MP7A1 Naga the ideal backup weapon.


[b]THERE'S MORE - THE FOLLOWING ORGELBOX NOW IN THE SHOP:
[/b]- SP Spring Orgelbox (including the EOTech and OpenDot variations of various weapons)

[h1]CLEAN UP IN OUR EVENTS[/h1]

Over the next 2 weeks we'll be starting up some events that can earn you some serious rewards.

[h1]SKILL NA: Rookie Server [/h1]
From now on, the access of Rookie Server is limited to users no older than 14 days. The tooltip hasn't been updated yet, so it still states the old conditions.

[b]Changelog in the forum[/b]

As always, you can read the full details in the [url=http://board.skill.gameforge.com]forum[/url].

Keep up to date with the latest news by following us on [url=http://twitter.com/skillsf2]Twitter[/url] and [url=http://www.facebook.com/skillsf2]Facebook[/url].

What are you waiting for – time to fight!

notes.title: This winter is heating up!
notes.content:
[img]https://image.board.gameforge.com/uploads/skillsf2/ww/announcement_skillsf2_ww_e697a1bcc93e626eb5d0c26bd2c59c0d.jpg[/img]

Soldiers,
Cold snap? Not on our watch! It's burning up in S.K.I.L.L.: a plentiful supply of powerful weapons, a new mercenary and loads of exciting events will all have you well-armed for winter!

Here's an overview of all the content heading your way:

[h1]UMP45 Skull Supreme[/h1]
From today, the new orgelbox UMP45 Skull Supreme is available in the shop. For the first time, you can win the legendary UMP45 Supreme as a main prize (not just as a special prize!), and it is available as the extraordinary and deadly Skull version. The best part: up to now the supreme weapons were exclusively available as a special win with the highest rarity, never as a point of focus as the main prize. 
Are you a winner? Then buy your capsule now!

[h1]CZ700 Naga[/h1]
New to the capsule market: the CZ 700 Naga! This Czech sniper rifle is a great choice for more than just snipers. The weapon is a reliable and absolutely savage weapon.

[h1]ESL Collection[/h1]
The ESL Pro League weapons are back, but the clock is ticking! Grab this special orgelbox before it is too late.

[h1]SP Box 'Snow FX'[/h1]
Available in the shop just in time for winter, the new SP box 'SnowFX'. Spite the cold weather and charge into the heat of battle with numerous weapons and two different winter camos.

[h1][b]1 NEW MERCENARY IN THE SHOP[/b][/h1]
New mercenary Velvet is now available! She's a real daredevil and will ensure that your battles are on fire!

[h1]Events, Events, Events[/h1]
Our range of exciting events is still tearing it up: till the 10th January there's daily events and fantastic rewards. Be sure not to miss them!
[h1][/h1]

[b]Change Log in the Forum[/b]
As always, the full details are available in the [url=http://board.skill.gameforge.com]forum[/url].
Keep up to date with the latest news by following us on [url=http://twitter.com/skillsf2]Twitter[/url] as well as [url=http://www.facebook.com/skillsf2]Facebook[/url].

What are you waiting for – battle stations!

notes.content:
Soldiers!

The long awaited content update has finally arrived. It includes a refreshed user interface for the shop and inventory, a new map and game settings, new weapons, bug fixes and more! Here's an overview of all improvements:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8806950/9c2eaba89cb5c875c46a3ab35fe9706cae3319cf.jpg[/img]

[*]Knives - only knives are allowed.
[*]Pistols - only pistols are allowed.
[*]Shotguns - only shotguns are allowed.
[*]Snipers - only snipers are allowed.
[*]All weapons - all available weapons can be used.[/list]Lobby host can now also select if the weapon-pick up should be allowed or not.

There are 3 modes available from now on in the standard channels:

[h1]New Events[/h1][list][*]Check our [url=http://y.gfsrv.net/skillevents]events list[/url].[/list]

notes.title: S.K.I.L.L. - Special Force 2 CAMO Design Contest!
notes.content:
Soldiers,

Weapons in S.K.I.L.L. come in all different variants, colours and designs. The variety of customization options are what makes the game unique. Today we offer you a chance to contribute towards that feature and express yourself even further trough your own CAMO design!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8806950/40ad58d36f62993a37baf821bd557115aec38923.jpg[/img]

[h1]Design Your Own CAMO[/h1]

We invite all the creative minds to join our contest. It doesn’t matter if you are an experienced designer with many weapon finishes in your portfolio or just a casual enthusiast. All you need to do is create your own pattern for a weapon CAMO and submit it to us. For the best three submissions we have prepared the following prizes:

[b]1st place:[/b]
[list][*]CAMO implementation in-game as a special Orgelbox.
[*]Permanent version of all 3 included weapons (HK417, CZ700 and FAMAS).
[*]€50 Gameforge Coupon.[/list]
[b]2nd place:[/b]
[list][*]12 capsules for the implemented Orgelbox.
[*]€25 Gameforge Coupon.[/list]
[b]3rd place:[/b]
[list][*]6 capsules for the implemented Orgelbox.

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards for S.K.I.L.L.!
notes.content:
Soldiers!

Starting today, you can get Steam Trading Cards for S.K.I.L.L.! For 8 of the mercenaries there is one cool card:[list][*]GROM
[*]Black Security
[*]GAFE Armored Unit
[*]SAS Mobility Troop
[*]GIGN Riot Guard
[*]Black Mamba
[*]Delta Scout
[*]Eagle Eye[/list]
[h1]How do I collect the cards?[/h1]

For every $9 USD that you spend in S.K.I.L.L. on Steam you will receive a random trading card. Top ups of CASH into the game using your Steam balance as well as purchases of the Steam DLC packs for S.K.I.L.L. both count towards this. DLC purchase guide can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=449641234
Alternatively you can also exchange and trade with other players on the Steam marketplace to then collect a complete set of all 8 cards.

notes.title: S.K.I.L.L. - Special Force 2 July Content Update!
notes.content:
Soldiers!

As requested by many of you the July’s supply drop has been delivered and it contains a lot of new weapons, gear, maps and features.  We have also applied some changes based on the feedback you have send to us via combat reports and social media. The list of changes includes:

[h1]New Guns & Equipment[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]M40A1 Shooting Dead[/b]
[*][b]GALIL Comic Boom[/b]
[*]M249 SPW Monster
[*]Smoke Grenade Green (Cash)

[*]King’s Temple / Game Mode: Round Sniper
[/list]

[b]UDT Counter Terror[/b] - is easily recognisable as a battle swimmer with his wetsuit, flippers and air tank. Permanent 60% expirence and 40% SP boost included.

[h1]Changes to VIP System[/h1]

As requested by many of you, we decided to change the VIP system to be more attractive and useful for those who support us by purchasing the VIP Packs. The changes include:
[list]
[*][b]VIP Host[/b] - from now on all the VIP players will be able to host VIP lobbies in the public channels and chose the exclusive new maps and modes. The lobbies are accessible for the non-VIP players too.

[*]VIP Server was disabled due to inactivity and replaced with the new VIP lobbies system.

[*]XIGNCODE3 Anti-Cheat Update

notes.title: New S.K.I.L.L. – Special Force 2 - Recruit Pack DLC!
notes.content:
Soldiers,

today our commanders released another downloadable content pack for all the fresh recruits, as well as some new in-game events and anti-cheat patches. Read the announcement below for further details:

[h1]The S.K.I.L.L. – Special Force 2 - Recruit Pack ([url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/373590/]Store Page[/url])[/h1]

The high-value [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/373590/]Recruit Pack[/url] offers these cool (and useful) items for S.K.I.L.L. – Special Force 2:
[list]
[*][b]Camo Spray Giganteus FX[/b] - use this spray on your weapon to permanently cover it in a spooky yet spectacular animation.

[*][b]G36C EOTech Giganteus FX[/b] - you receive the popular G36C assault rifle with the very useful EOTech visor for seven days – already coated in the Giganteus FX camo spray. As with all temporary weapons in S.K.I.L.L. – Special Force 2, this weapon does not need to be repaired over the seven days that it is available: you save a lot of SP!

[*][b]MP5K[/b] - one of the most popular submachine guns in S.K.I.L.L. is the MP5K – this pack secures you the permanent variant of the gun. The MP5K is perfectly suited for all close combat situations, for example in team deathmatch on the Hangar map!

[*][b]EXP Booster (100%)[/b] - for 1 day you will get double the amount of experience points after each match when you activate this booster. Perfect for ascending the ranks quickly!

[*][b]M14 TH3[/b] - this grenade is your alternative to the standard M67 grenade. The M14 TH3 sets everything within meters alight after detonation, lasting for a few seconds. It's the perfect method for stopping your enemies, especially when they need to defuse the bomb in Blasting!
[/list]
If you are interested in purchasing one but you are not sure how to do it, we created a short DLC redeeming guide: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=449641234]click here[/url]. The list of all available DLCs can be found [url=http://store.steampowered.com/dlc/286940/]here[/url].

[h1]New Events[/h1]

Every player who logs in between 5th June 15:00 CEST and 14th June 23:59 CEST will receive a thank-you item bundle (only once per account). Be sure to like and follow us on our social media linked below for more rewards like this!
